meta: Ask AI to help you build an emergency fund and a 6-month savings plan: without one, a single illness or job loss means borrowing.

muc.title: No emergency fund yet
muc.text: Without an emergency fund, one illness or job loss means borrowing. AI can help you plan six months of saving.

muc.title: List your fixed costs
muc.text: List your essential monthly costs: rent, food, utilities, transport. Write amounts only, no account numbers.

muc.title: Split it by month
muc.text: Ask AI to add it up, set a fund target of a few months of essentials, then split it by month.

muc.title: Adjust if it's too much
muc.text: If it's too much, ask AI to find costs to cut or stretch the plan. Ask a professional where to keep the money.

muc.title: A six-month savings table
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a six-month savings table, then set a reminder to transfer money on payday.

thu: Ask a chatbot for a six-month savings table, then set a reminder to transfer money on payday.
